body.name: Published singleton-permitting blocked state class
body.construction:
The published blocked edge-coloured superclass, specialized to unrestricted target-specific innovation variances, is
\[
\mathfrak S_p=\left\{A=(\mathcal K,\Xi):\mathcal K\text{ is an acyclic directed graph on }V,\ \Xi_j\text{ is a partition of }\operatorname{pa}_{\mathcal K}(j)\text{ for every }j\in V\right\}.
\]
Singleton blocks are permitted. The BPEC class is the proper subclass in which no edge-colour block is a singleton.
